note: Peak on day 4 (19 Jul) of an ongoing wave. Day 2 (17 Jul), evening, Ivan Franko Square: «близько 3 тисяч людей» (LB, own correspondent), which several newsrooms say exceeded day 1 — Kyiv24: the square «зібрала значно більше людей, ніж у перший день акції», the largest influx around 20:00; solidarity signs also appeared at Atlas Festival. Day-2 morning was «близько 200 учасників» (Suspilne, NV). Day-1 peak was about two thousand (Interfax «близько двох тисяч», LB «понад тисяча», Kyiv Post «several thousand», AFP «more than a thousand»); Suspilne's «сотні» was a stale round-up line, not its own Kyiv reporting. «понад 10 тис.» for the day-2 evening was a real Interfax-Ukraine report (per Espreso citing «Інтерфакс-Україна»), not the snippet-fabrication class of day 1's «кілька тисяч»; still, LB's own correspondent on the scene gave «близько 3 тисяч», so that conservative figure is kept as the peak and the ~3x discrepancy flagged (aggregators Telegraf and mignews circulated «10 тис.» too). Suspilne still has no Kyiv desk, but a dedicated Kyiv article now exists (LB), unlike day 1. No police or city-administration estimate. Day 3 (18 Jul) went ahead on the same square (called by Dmytro Koziatynskyi): the action ran from ~15:00, and Suspilne — covering Kyiv directly this time, unlike day 1 — recorded «близько 300» at 19:30 rising to «близько 2 тисяч» at 21:45, below the day-2 peak, so the two-day figure stands. Demands widened to Syrskyi's dismissal and Fedorov's reappointment; solidarity rallies were also held abroad (Warsaw, Brussels, Sydney). Day 4 (19 Jul) is the largest yet: Interfax-Ukraine (via LIGA) reported «понад 5000» on Ivan Franko Square, now the wave peak — the late-evening «кількасот» (5.ua, 21:31) is a thinned slice. The ministry is still unfilled (Khmara acting, Klymenko's candidacy not submitted, Rada in recess to 18 Aug), so the protests continue into a fourth day.

Two waves. The morning action ran until 11:00, then participants dispersed and regathered at 13:00 ahead of the parliamentary session. The «ОНОВЛЕНО. 13:30» block reads «понад 60, і люди продовжують підходити»; below it, «понад сто людей» about the 13:00 gathering. Day 2 (17 Jul): a second-day action was called for 18:00 opposite the City Garden (OBOZ); Day 4 (19 Jul) was far larger: «На вулиці Дерибасівській зібралися близько тисячі людей» (24 Kanal, citing Suspilne) — a ~7× surge from day 1 and the Odesa wave peak. «Близько тисячі» sits at the 1000 boundary and is single-source, so it is marked contested and taken as 1000+ by the «близько сотні»→100–999 convention; day-1 «понад сто» and the day-2 18:00 action are the earlier points.

«Акція не має терміну тривалості». Correspondents give «орієнтовно дві сотні людей», police «орієнтовно 200». The early 0342.ua slice, «десятки», is 09:34, while the crowd was gathering. Held despite an air-raid alert. Relatives of fallen soldiers attended, including a woman carrying a photograph of her son killed near Pokrovsk. Shevchenko Boulevard, opposite the city council. The article dateModified reads 15:07, but the text is the morning version: the figure is valid for 09:48.
A rare case: an own count with two time points. Censor independently confirms «близько 60 учасників» at 09:30. The city was absent from the announcement.
